name: TorBox jobs
description: Runs magnets, torrent files, NZBs and web links as jobs on a TorBox account.

codes.torbox_jobs.auth_invalid: The TorBox API key is invalid or expired. Enter it again.
codes.torbox_jobs.cooldown: TorBox is holding this account in a cooldown. Waiting.
codes.torbox_jobs.job_exists: TorBox already holds a job for this content
codes.torbox_jobs.job_failed: TorBox ended this job with an error
codes.torbox_jobs.job_gone: TorBox no longer holds this job
codes.torbox_jobs.job_incomplete: TorBox could not fetch every file of this job
codes.torbox_jobs.job_unavailable: TorBox reports this job as unavailable
codes.torbox_jobs.limit_reached: TorBox reports the plan limit as reached
codes.torbox_jobs.no_entropy: The host could not supply the randomness this request needs
codes.torbox_jobs.no_files: TorBox reports this job as finished but lists no files
codes.torbox_jobs.no_job_id: TorBox did not name the job it created. Check your TorBox account before trying again.
codes.torbox_jobs.no_selection: TorBox downloads whole jobs and offers no file selection. Pick the files in the LinkGrabber.
codes.torbox_jobs.not_a_job: This is not a magnet, a torrent file, an NZB or a web address
codes.torbox_jobs.not_permitted: The TorBox plan does not cover this kind of job
